artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: Source change only; the release is OG-r-1's. Principal(tid, oid, email) with principal_key(tid, oid) = '<tid>/<oid>' (canonical GUIDs) as the authorization identity and the email as display metadata; set_current_principal for the MCP/REST paths; authorized_tenants() = the configured TENANT_ID, fail closed when unset (MOCK_GRAPH only: the mock tenant). Unchanged since d02e73c272 (git diff --quiet d02e73c272 HEAD rc=0).

Source change only. The /authorize bridge asks the upstream for OpenID scopes only (AUTHENTICATION_SCOPES); the callback validates the ID token (authorized tenant before any key fetch, RS256 against the tenant's published key, exact issuer, audience = client id, expiry, the nonce derived from this sign-in's state, GUID tid/oid) and returns the principal. Graph-using tools acquire their delegated token silently from the principal's cache when they run; the machine routes' fixed identities keep email-keyed caches; the legacy /login consent writes both (row W3-S10). An unconfigured upstream fails closed before any network call. Unchanged since d02e73c272 (git diff --quiet d02e73c272 HEAD rc=0).

Source change only. Codes, refresh families and access tokens bind principal_key(tid, oid); access tokens carry tver=2, tid, oid, sub=<tid>/<oid>, email (display) and fid. validate_access_token refuses a legacy token (no tver or principal) while its exp is valid, an unauthorized tenant, and a family that is not live now, is bound to another principal or no longer grants the token's scope, then applies the kill path. Pre-cutover code records and refresh families are refused with invalid_grant. Unchanged since d02e73c272 (git diff --quiet d02e73c272 HEAD rc=0).

Source change only. /mcp, /teams/poll and /query/v0 take their principal only from the validated token (_bearer_principal). _resource_error: a missing credential gets 401 + 'Bearer resource_metadata=...' with no error code; an invalid token gets 401 + error="invalid_token"; a valid token lacking the scope gets 403 insufficient_scope with the scope; unreadable state gets 503. The per-identity rate limit is keyed by principal; the bridge callback mints the code for the validated principal. Unchanged since d02e73c272 (git diff --quiet d02e73c272 HEAD rc=0).

Source change only. is_principal_revoked (a principal-key line revokes that principal alone; an email line only adds denial); a family id on the jti list revokes that family's access tokens; revoke_principal and its CLI verb. Unchanged since d02e73c272 (git diff --quiet d02e73c272 HEAD rc=0).
